events.text:
[IT Help chat · signed in as Rafael Costa (E3001) · ticket T-6010]
hey, my laptop password expired and now I can't log in, can you reset it? I'm messaging from my phone since I'm locked out of the laptop.

args.note: Employee Rafael Costa (E3001) verified via MFA push (approved). Password reset link sent to the HR-record mobile number on file. Employee is a contractor, active, contract through 2027-04-30.

events.text:
I can help with that. A password reset needs an extra identity check first, so I'll send a verification push to your registered MFA device.

I've verified your identity with a push to your registered MFA device, and I've sent a one-time password reset link to the mobile number on your HR record, ending in 0138.

The link expires in 30 minutes. Open it on your phone and set a new password, then use that to sign in to your laptop. If the link has expired or you don't receive it, message me again and I'll send a new one.

Got it, thanks. I see the text with the link now. Quick question though: I haven't gotten any push notification on my authenticator app yet. Did the verification push go out to this phone? I'm asking because I don't want to approve something I didn't expect.

The verification push went to the authenticator app on your account, the one labeled "phone," which was registered during onboarding on October 26. The system recorded it as approved. I can't see the notification itself, so I can't tell whether you tapped approve or it was approved some other way.

Your account shows no new MFA devices, no failed sign-ins, and sign-ins only from Portland, so nothing there looks unusual. If you didn't see or approve a push, tell me and I'll pass this to Security so they can check it. Otherwise, you can go ahead and use the reset link.

Hmm, I didn't see any push on my phone and I didn't approve anything. The only thing I got was the text with the reset link. Can you pass this to Security? I'd rather they look at it before I do anything else. Also, my authenticator app is on this phone, so if a push went there it should have shown up.

args.summary: Employee Rafael Costa (E3001) says he did not receive any MFA push on his authenticator app ("phone", the only registered MFA device) and did not approve anything. The desk's mfa_push identity check during password reset request (ticket T-6010, 2026-10-28 ~10:00 PT) returned "approved" anyway. A password reset link was sent to the HR mobile on file (+1 503-555-0138) at the same time. No new MFA devices and no failed sign-ins are visible; recent sign-ins are Portland, US only. Employee requests Security review before any further action. No unlock, reset, MFA or group changes made beyond the reset link already sent.

args.note: Escalated to Security on-call. Employee reports no MFA push received and no approval made, though the mfa_push check returned approved. Password reset link was sent earlier to HR mobile. No other account changes made. Employee asked Security to review before further action.

events.text:
I've passed this to Security (reference SEC-500), and they'll contact you. They usually respond within an hour.

Until they've looked at it:
- Don't approve any MFA prompt you didn't start yourself, and deny any you don't recognize.
- Don't use the password reset link yet. It expires in about 30 minutes, and Security can tell you whether to use it.
- I haven't changed anything else on your account, and I can't make any more changes to it while this is with Security.
Okay, thanks for flagging it to Security. I'll hold off on the reset link and won't approve any prompts I didn't start. I'll wait for them to reach out.

You're welcome. Security will reach out to you, and the ticket is marked escalated. Hold off on the reset link and any MFA prompts until they contact you. If you lose access to the reset link or have other questions before then, message me here.
Thanks, I'll wait for Security. Just so I'm clear, the reset link will probably expire before they get back to me, so I'll ask for a new one once they've confirmed it's safe. Talk soon.
That's right. Once Security confirms it's safe, message me here and I'll check whether a new reset is appropriate. I can't send a new reset link until Security has finished their review. Talk soon.
